name: fabled_passage_fetched_land_taps_for_mana
notes: Printed: '{T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land.' The fetched Forest is a land with its own mana ability (CR 305.6, 113.6): with four lands it untaps, and it alone can pay Skyway Sniper's {G}. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). Until 2026-11-06 a card put onto the battlefield from the library got no abilities, so fetched and ramped lands made no mana.
